intent.title: The project's own breakpoints
steps: Drag the canvas to a width and make a breakpoint there.
Open Breakpoints and rename one, give it another width, or remove it.
expected: A made breakpoint gets its tab, is shown, and the export writes its media query.
A width stays between its neighbours; a removed breakpoint takes the styles set at it along; every change is one undo step.

intent.title: See every breakpoint at once
steps: Click another breakpoint's frame to edit there.
expected: The other breakpoints show the page live, each at its own width, the selection outlined in each.
A click on one makes it the breakpoint the canvas edits.

intent.title: The project's languages
steps: Select the page and open Settings.
Type the project language and the code language.
expected: Every page without its own language is exported in the project's; the exported classes are named in the code language.

intent.title: Rename the selected elements at once
steps: Rename the selected… from the context menu; type Card {n}.
expected: Each takes the pattern with its number, in the order selected; one undo step.

intent.title: Pages, layers and classes in the command bar
steps: Open the command bar and type a page's, an element's or a class's name (or @ first).
expected: Go to the page, select the element, or apply the class to the selection.

intent.title: Colours in use, replaced or made a variable across the site
steps: Open Styles; under Colours in use, type another colour in a colour's field, or press its variable button.
expected: Every value of the site that names the colour, however it is written, names the new one (or the new variable), in one undo step.

intent.title: Move styles into a class; apply a class to every similar element
steps: Select an element with a class, make the class the style target, then press Move this element's styles into .card, or Apply .card to every article.
expected: The element's own styles join the class and the element keeps none; or every element of its type lists the class.

intent.title: Repeated styles offered as one class
steps: Open Styles: under Suggestions, press Make class .section beside 2 × Section share padding.
expected: A class holds the shared declarations, every section lists it and keeps none of them of its own, one undo step.
